issue_context.title: Fix non-standard quadpoints orders for annotations
issue_context.body:
I have made a PDF file that serves as a minimal reduced test case for all annotation types with quadpoints support. Currently all markup annotations are supported for quadpoints (highlight, underline, strikethrough and squiggly annotations), but link annotations can also have quadpoints which we don't support yet. This can be done similar to the existing annotation types, but in my test file I actually ran into https://stackoverflow.com/questions/9855814/pdf-spec-vs-acrobat-creation-quadpoints which should be addressed first before we can do that.

In short:
- Handle https://stackoverflow.com/questions/9855814/pdf-spec-vs-acrobat-creation-quadpoints properly.
- Implement quadpoints support for link annotations.
- Include the reduced test case for all types.
comments: Yes, that sounds like a good idea since I'll need to touch that particular code anyway; thanks!

review_comments:
Really good comment!

However, the fact that all of this special-casing is even necessary feels somewhat sad; why is it that Annotations in particular seem to deviate *so much* from the specification in many cases :-(

I feel the same. I can only guess that implementation errors were made before and fixing it properly would mean breaking existing PDF files, so they had to go with a backwards compatible solution, forcing other tools to also consider those cases. However, the fact that Adobe applications violate their own specification also gets a sad face from me :-(
